_provenance_note: A4's instruction: threshold tuning for esco-skill-extractor must happen on JDs OUTSIDE the 33-JD eval corpus (jds_v2.json), or it's fitted to the set it's later measured against. These 8 are live postings fetched directly from Greenhouse's public job-board API (boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{company}/jobs/{id}) on 2026-08-30, from two companies (Asana, Gusto) that appear nowhere in jds_v2.json's 33 -- checked against that file's company field before picking these, not after. Deliberately spans a mix of technical (Data Scientist, Data Engineer, AI Engineer) and non-technical (Chief Accounting Officer, Commercial Counsel, Field Marketing Manager, Compliance Manager, Product Designer) roles, since threshold behavior plausibly differs by domain the same way coverage did in the main benchmark.

asana_cao.title: Chief Accounting Officer
asana_cao.text:
We're looking for a strategic and collaborative leader to join Asana as our Chief Accounting Officer. In this pivotal role, you will guide our global financial operations, overseeing our Accounting, controllership, billing, and revenue accounting functions. You will lead a high-performing finance team that tracks and seeks to understand the factors driving our growth and success, helping our entire organization achieve its operational and financial goals while embodying our company values. As a core financial leader and Section 16 Officer, you will partner closely with cross-functional executive stakeholders to ensure our business objectives are feasible and our long-term growth is built on an enduring foundation of operational excellence.

What you'll achieve
- Lead Asana's global Accounting, controllership, billing, and revenue accounting functions
- Serve as an executive Section 16 Officer, ensuring highest financial integrity standards
- Oversee accurate and timely execution of financial close processes and reporting
- Partner with cross-functional executives to build scalable financial infrastructure
- Develop and maintain robust internal controls and accounting policies
- Mentor and empower a diverse, high-performing team

About you
- Proven executive leadership managing accounting operations as CAO or Controller in public companies
- Deep Section 16 Officer expertise with SEC regulations and US GAAP knowledge
- Exceptional cross-functional communicator translating complex financial structures into strategic insights
- Curious about AI tools and emerging technologies

asana_counsel.title: Commercial Counsel
asana_counsel.text:
Asana seeks a Commercial Counsel for their Legal team in San Francisco. This role supports the global sales organization through high-velocity deal cycles across multiple regions.

Key Responsibilities
- Partner closely with sales teams and cross-functional stakeholders to support high-velocity deal cycles
- Draft and negotiate commercial agreements, including SaaS deals and data protection agreements
- Serve as trusted advisor to sales, delivering timely and practical guidance
- Train sales teams on commercial best practices
- Develop scalable frameworks and legal playbooks
- Monitor emerging regulations affecting the business
- Manage ad hoc legal projects

Requirements
- J.D. from accredited institution; active bar membership
- 4+ years legal experience with significant in-house technology background
- Experience with enterprise SaaS agreements and related documents
- Cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Finance, Deal Desk, Privacy, Security
- Strong judgment and ability to translate dense legal nuances into clear recommendations
- Solutions-oriented approach; comfort with ambiguity

asana_marketing.title: Field Marketing Manager
asana_marketing.text:
Field Marketing Manager, North America. The role focuses on developing and executing field marketing programs for North America.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and own the field marketing program for North America across owned and sponsored events from concept through completion
- Partner with sales leaders on pipeline acceleration strategies
- Collaborate on cross-functional event execution involving ABM, Brand, and Customer Advocacy teams
- Establish repeatable processes and best practices for regional activities
- Track program performance, KPIs, and ROI

Required Qualifications
- 4+ years of field marketing experience in enterprise B2B/SaaS
- Deep event planning and management knowledge with a proven track record of successfully executing multifaceted events
- Strong cross-functional leadership abilities
- Self-starter with project management skills adaptable to fast-paced environments
- Marketing technology proficiency (Salesforce, Marketo)
- Ability to travel regionally as needed
- Curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies

asana_designer.title: Senior Product Designer, Onboarding & Adoption
asana_designer.text:
Asana is seeking a Senior Product Designer focused on onboarding and user adoption in AI. The role involves designing adaptive experiences, prototyping, and collaborating with product managers, engineers, researchers, and data scientists.

Key Responsibilities
- Design and iterate on onboarding and adoption experiences that help users quickly discover value in Asana
- Rapidly prototype concepts to explore ideas and accelerate team learning
- Partner with PMs and engineers in iterative product development
- Stay current on emerging AI and LLM capabilities
- Use qualitative insights and product data to inform design decisions
- Contribute to design system evolution

Requirements
- 5+ years product design experience with portfolio demonstrating work on onboarding, growth, or AI experiences
- Deep curiosity about AI products and interaction patterns
- Strong prototyping skills and maker mindset
- Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-moving environments
- Exceptional visual and interaction design craft

asana_ds.title: Data Scientist
asana_ds.text:
The Data Science team helps us fulfill our mission by informing strategy, defining success metrics, and identifying new ways to deliver user value. Data scientists leverage experimentation, statistical analysis, and machine learning to understand customers and drive business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
- Design and analyze experiments measuring new product feature impact
- Investigate questions about successful team collaboration patterns using Asana
- Add metrics and aggregations to the data warehouse
- Build predictive models for customer segment growth trajectories
- Partner across engineering, product, and business teams for data-driven decisions

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Engineering, or related quantitative field
- 3+ years applying data science to technical product development
- Strong statistics, mathematics, or information science background
- Fluency in Python or Scala
- SQL and relational data modeling proficiency
- Expertise in statistical methods and experimental design
- Experience with distributed systems (Spark, Redshift)
- Advanced statistical modeling and machine learning knowledge

asana_de.title: Data Engineer
asana_de.text:
The Data Engineering team at Asana seeks to ensure high-quality data to enable data-informed decision-making across the organization. This position involves building data artifacts for marketing stakeholders and creating frameworks for analytics engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities
- Design and scale end-to-end data products supporting analytical needs
- Influence best practices in Databricks and cloud-based data engineering
- Leverage AI to build self-serve tools
- Establish cross-functional relationships on data strategy
- Implement systems ensuring data quality, governance, and availability

Requirements
- 3+ years Data Engineering or Software Engineering experience
- Computer Science degree or equivalent technical background
- Proficiency with Databricks, Spark, Airflow
- Fluent SQL and modern programming language (Python, Scala, Java)
- Strong communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences

gusto_compliance.title: Compliance Manager, Broker-Dealer & Investment Adviser
gusto_compliance.text:
This role serves as the operational backbone of Gusto's Retirement Compliance Team, reporting to the Compliance Lead (Director). The position requires balancing strategic oversight with hands-on execution across both RIA and BD entities.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing FINRA state registration obligations and employee registration filings (U4/U5)
- Leading annual compliance testing cycles across advertising, complaints, AML, trade errors, and books and records
- Owning electronic communications surveillance via Global Relay
- Administering advertising approval and FINRA submissions
- Managing Code of Ethics attestations and client agreements
- Supporting regulatory filings including ADV and CRS
- Creating compliance training materials
- Managing compliance technology tools and configurations

Required Qualifications
- 5+ compliance experience at a FINRA-registered broker-dealer and SEC-registered investment adviser
- Expertise in FINRA Rules, SEC regulations, and the Bank Secrecy Act
- Hands-on compliance testing experience
- Active SIE, Series 7, and Series 24 licenses
- Familiarity with compliance technology platforms
- Strong documentation and written communication skills

gusto_ai_eng.title: Enterprise Application AI Engineer
gusto_ai_eng.text:
Gusto seeks an Enterprise Application AI Engineer to lead AI and automation integration across enterprise systems. This role bridges business needs with AI-driven solutions, designing Model Context Protocols and agents to transform internal workflows.

Key Responsibilities
- Translate business requirements into AI workflows for Finance and Operations teams
- Develop and maintain Model Context Protocols connecting systems like NetSuite, Zuora, and Jira to AI agents
- Create intelligent agents for processes including onboarding, billing support, and compliance monitoring
- Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, security standards, and SOX requirements
- Measure impact through KPIs tracking automation adoption, efficiency gains, and cost performance

Required Qualifications
- 8+ years in Business Systems Analysis, Enterprise Applications, or Automation
- Experience building integrations with APIs, JSON, and RESTful services
- Hands-on knowledge of AI frameworks: LangChain, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, MCP
- Familiarity with major LLM platforms and prompt engineering experience
- Proficiency in Python or JavaScript for automation and workflow orchestration
- Strong documentation and stakeholder communication skills
